requirement:
After a rejection under {cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.rejection`,
a submission whose `rationale` is exactly the UUID that rejection gave MUST
resolve to the rejected submission unchanged, ignoring the new submission's
other fields; acceptance remains subject to
{cite}`requirements.authoring.submission.searches.line_numbers`. After passing that gate, any other rationale that cites line numbers MUST fail
the assessment, so
an assessment rejects at most one submission. The UUID MUST NOT be recorded in
evidence.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover every obligation in `requirements.authoring.line_numbers.resubmission`.

- **A rationale exactly equal to the rejection's UUID resolves to the rejected submission unchanged, ignoring the new submission's other fields.**
  - `src/authoring/line_numbers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_rejection_gives_a_uuid_that_keeps_the_rejected_submission]` extracts the UUID from the rejection message. It submits `{determination: true, rationale: uuid}` and asserts `resubmitted` returns exactly the original cited value, whose determination is false. This shows the new determination is ignored.
  - The same test asserts that a rationale of the UUID plus a trailing space returns `None`, which checks the "exactly" condition. It also asserts `resubmitted` is `None` before any rejection.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once]` runs this end to end through `assess`. Its first case submits the UUID with a different determination and asserts the evidence rationale is the original cited text.
- **Acceptance of the retained submission is subject to the outstanding-search gate.** `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[search_gate_preserves_line_number_correction_and_uuid_resubmission]` has `RetainRejected` submitted while a search is outstanding. The tool result mentions "outstanding searches", and the retained submission is accepted only after `Finish`. The final judgment is `False` with the original rationale.
- **After passing that gate, any other rationale that cites line numbers fails the assessment, so at most one submission is rejected.**
  - The third case in `a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once` has a second line-number rationale fail with "after a rejection".
  - The unit test also asserts that a clean resubmission is accepted and that a repeated citing rationale yields `Outcome::Fail`.
  - `a_second_line_number_rationale_fails_only_after_searches_are_finished` checks the ordering. A second cited rationale submitted while a search is outstanding is rejected for outstanding searches. It fails with "after a rejection" only after `Finish`, and the usage determination is not recorded earlier.
- **The UUID is not recorded in evidence.** The first case in `a_rationale_citing_line_numbers_is_rejected_once` asserts that the evidence JSON does not match a UUID regex. The unit test also asserts a fresh rejection gives a different UUID.
- **An outstanding-search rejection does not consume the resubmission.** The search-gate test checks that the request after the first outstanding-search rejection has no "rationale set to exactly" text. The UUID guidance appears only after the later line-number rejection. Resubmission is still available after a second outstanding-search rejection.

All obligations the subject states have tests with concrete assertions. All the tests carry `{test}` references to the subject.

For requirement, example, and site reviews and their verifications, when the only submission in a response under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.submission`, or a `submit_verification` call under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.verifier_prompt`, is otherwise valid but its
rationale cites line numbers under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.line_numbers.detection`, and it is the
assessment's first such submission, and it passes the outstanding-search gate
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.submission.searches.line_numbers`, the
harness MUST reject it instead of
accepting it and continue the conversation. The tool result MUST quote the
matched text, repeat the location guidance of
{cite}`requirements.authoring.judgment_rules`, and give a fresh random UUID,
saying the model may submit once more, either without line numbers or with
`rationale` set to exactly that UUID to keep the rejected submission as it was.
A rejection MUST be counted in usage like any other turn.
:::{req} submission.searches.line_numbers
After validating submission arguments or resolving the UUID resubmission
form, the outstanding-search gate MUST precede line-number rejection or
acceptance. An outstanding-search rejection MUST NOT consume the line-number
resubmission or submission reminder.
